name: Xuchang

queries.query: Xuchang official real estate registration center cadastral parcel map public GIS China
queries.result: The official Xuchang bureau publishes a city Real Estate Registration Trading Center and registration guide. Public account services include property-information queries subject to identity matching; parcel-map attachments are linked to certificates for rights holders. The city Tianditu map provides general map services, while API calls require developer authorization; no anonymous cadastral feature feed was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The Xuchang Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and Real Estate Registration Trading Center serve the city. Public records identify rights-holder-specific property query/map access. No citywide anonymous parcel-vector coverage was verified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: City title-registration records are confirmed. The public city Tianditu map provides generic map services; documented API authorization and identity-checked registry services do not provide anonymous full parcel geometry.

registryBasis: Xuchang’s official city bureau identifies the local Real Estate Registration Trading Center and its property-registration/query services. Information queries require identity matching; parcel map attachments are accessible through rights-holder certificate QR codes.
technicalBlocker: Official property information is identity-verified, and title-certificate parcel maps are rights-holder-specific. The public city map’s API/services require developer authorization; no open parcel endpoint or safe feature schema is published in reviewed materials.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separately documented public cadastral layer exists for Xuchang, and whether the WUP centroid is covered by any anonymous parcel service, remain unknown.
nextStep: Only pursue an officially documented public cadastral service that returns full geometry with an explicit safe attribute allowlist; do not use registration accounts, identity matching, or certificate QR access.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: Source discovery only. No full parcel polygons, owner/address data, account credentials, tokens or feature responses were retained.
